# KLERQ

> KLERQ is legal experience management software for law firms — turning closed matters into one reusable source of evidence for directory submissions, pitches, referrals and conferences.

KLERQ is built only for law firms, ISO 27001 certified, hosted on Microsoft Azure, and used by 6,000+ users across 15 countries.

## Product
- [Solutions](/solutions.html): Submissions, Presentations & Pitches, Referral Management, Conferences
- [Submissions](/solutions-submissions.html): 19+ directory templates, including Chambers & Partners, Legal 500 and IFLR1000
- [Presentations & Pitches](/solutions-presentations.html): turn approved experience into a pitch in minutes
- [Referral Management](/solutions-referrals.html): relationship and ranking data for choosing a referral partner
- [Conferences](/solutions-conferences.html): plan, prep and follow up on events
- [How It Works](/how-it-works.html): the capture, approve, reuse, win workflow
- [Security](/security.html): ISO 27001 certification, Azure hosting, access and audit controls
- [Pricing](/pricing.html): from €500/month for 10 users (EU); other regions by request
